ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. The left tip features a large, mottled white region with irregular boundaries. The right tip displays a smaller, denser white patch. The remainder of the surface consists of a low-intensity black background with scattered high-intensity focal points.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Extracted edge contains non-uniform peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels, isolated clearly against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave mathematical curves extending from the outer tips toward the central notch apex.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent vertical high-intensity linear disruption on the left lobe adjacent to the notch. Multiple intersecting and parallel diagonal linear scratches are mapped across the lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple sets of parallel linear rake marks across both lobes; a significant cluster of white, raised-texture scarring/parasitic colonization on the far right margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique elongated vertical white scar on the interior left lobe and a dense 'patchwork' of diagonal abrasions on the lower right lobe.
